lines.t: You were made from him, not only for him
Heart of his heart, breath of his breath
Pulled from the dark and the endless scrolling
Loose every chain, fall into my rest
Stop climbing that cold glass mountain trust
Stop chasing that wind as you're crawling up
Look to your side, he's already with you
Love in his eyes, his hand lifting you
We are one in you, yahushua
808s under our feet, heaven over our head
Inferior lights, trap drums colliding
In the prophet's reward, until your fullness and rest
We are one in you, yahushua, your light in our veins, your fire in our chest
Children of God, predestined in the beloved, lost in your oneness, we live, we're blessed
Be loving, you are receptive because of me I am your cover and I am enough
Fall into me like a drop into the ocean Let every boundary break into my love
Grab hold with your heart, not your weary flesh
Let every burden melt into the floor
Hear his whisper in the reverb and the silence
One breath, one body forevermore
We are one in you, Yahushua
Eight of wings under our feet, heaven over our head
Ethereal eyes, trap drums collide
And the prophets reward until your fullness and rest
We are one in you, Yahushua
You are your life in our veins, your fire in our chest
Children of God, predestined in the beloved
Draw us in oneness, we're found, we're blessed
Yahushua
Thanks for watching!
